desc: Approve an app for installation on a workspace.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

allow_child_auto_install.desc: Auto-create an Admin-Approved App automation rule that pre-approves future child app installs from this manager app.

app_id.desc: The id of the app to approve.

request_id.desc: The id of the request to approve.

team_id.desc: The ID of the workspace to approve the app on

enterprise_id.desc: The ID of the enterprise to approve the app on

user_scopes.desc: User scopes to approve for the app

bot_scopes.desc: Bot scopes to approve for the app

app_management_app_not_installed_on_org.desc: The app management app must be installed on the org.

app_not_eligible_for_auto_install.desc: The app does not have the required scope to be eligible for auto-install rule creation.

app_restricted_org_wide.desc: The app is already restricted org wide.

auto_install_rule_creation_failed.desc: The app was approved successfully, but the auto-install AAA rule could not be created. Please create the rule manually.

custom_integration_not_allowed_at_enterp.desc: Returned when the install request is for custom integration app.

feature_not_enabled.desc: Returned when the Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this team.

org_resolution_required.desc: The `team_id` is in an Enterprise org while `app_id` is certified.

invalid_scopes.desc: Some of the provided scopes do not exist.

not_allowed_to_create_automation_rule.desc: The actor does not have permission to create AAA automation rules. The app was approved but the auto-install rule was not created.

not_an_admin.desc: This method is only accessible by org owners and admins.

request_already_resolved.desc: The app request has already been resolved.

request_id_required_for_custom_integrati.desc: A `request_id` is required for custom integrations.

team_not_found.desc: Returned when team id is not found.
